preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 0 < len(stdin) <= 5000000 and all(c.isalnum() for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Input is a non-empty string of length up to 5,000,000, consisting only of Latin letters and digits.

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and int(stdout) == sum(max(k for k in range(0, len(prefix) + 1) if is_k_palindrome(prefix, k)) for prefix in [stdin[:i] for i in range(1, len(stdin) + 1)])
postconditions.description: Output is the sum of the palindrome degrees of all prefixes of the input string, where the palindrome degree of a prefix is the maximum k such that the prefix is a k-palindrome.
